problem: Restaurants lose orders to missed phone calls and hold times; staff are overwhelmed.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription voice AI agent integrated with POS

founders.name: Gurveer Singh
founders.background_notes: Grew up around family restaurants (family chain Punjab per TechCentral); born in Durban, raised in Cape Town; applied to YC twice

competitors.name: SoundHound AI
competitors.what: Voice AI phone and omnichannel ordering for restaurants, integrated with POS systems
competitors.traction_then: Company states deployment in thousands of restaurant locations (Feb 2025 release)

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time voice agent with order accuracy, multilingual handling and POS and delivery integrations (Toast, Square, Clover, Uber Eats, DoorDash); strong foundation models from OpenAI and Google (per TechCentral) were available by mid-2025, so the hard part was integration and accuracy, not research.

defensibility.rationale: POS integrations create modest friction; voice-AI wrappers are widely copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: SoundHound already sold phone ordering to restaurant chains in early 2025 and POS vendors integrate such tools; too early for an outcome (Certus listed Active as of Nov 2026).

market_need_then: Founders cite restaurants losing up to $100k per location per year to missed calls (company claim, unverified); the CEO helped his parents' restaurant chain with phones and web (TechCentral, Oct 2025). SoundHound's restaurant deployments show real spend on phone ordering.

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Answer every call. Take every order.

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search found no press on the name, logo or community; coverage describes the product only. A Trustpilot page shows the company disputing a review as fake, which is not evidence of brand pull.

outcome_analysis: Certus AI is a Summer 2025 YC company, still listed Active in November 2026, so there is no exit or shutdown to explain. The team went through YC on its second application, and founders with restaurant operating experience sell a voice agent into a segment where SoundHound and other vendors already operated before the batch. Funding is only reported by aggregators (about $500K, likely the YC deal) and a TechCentral line about a multimillion-rand round, so traction beyond company claims is unverified; later entrants such as Loman and Maple appear only in vendor comparison blogs.
notes: Searches done: outcome (none found), funding, funding cross-check (TechCentral and Digital Journal fetched), dated competitor, branding. Funding: aggregators list $500K pre-seed (Oct or Sep 2025) led by YC, with one listing $2M total; TechCentral says only a multimillion-rand round; none gives a primary source, so no round is recorded (unverified, probably YC's standard deal plus small angels). Founder ages come from TechCentral (Oct 2025). Competitor: only SoundHound is dated near the batch (BusinessWire 2025-02-25); Slang.ai, Hostie, Loman and Maple appear in vendor comparison blogs dated after the batch or undated, so are not listed. Founding year 2025 per directory; TechCentral says the company was registered in the UK first. Logo not viewable.
